description: This Java source file defines the PoliciesConflictingException class, a custom exception indicating that a Thing cannot be modified due to conflicting Policy definitions. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON, and a builder class for flexible creation.

classes.name: PoliciesConflictingException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a Thing modification conflicts with existing policies, indicating whether an inline policy and a policy ID are both present.

classes.name: PoliciesConflictingException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of PoliciesConflictingException with a fluent API.

methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for PoliciesConflictingException, optionally associated with a specific ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PoliciesConflictingException instance from an error message and headers.

methods.description: Creates a PoliciesConflictingException instance from a JSON object and headers.
